 Health Canada issued a product recall notice for Simmons Kozy and Nido baby nests and loungers sold in Canada though Walmart, Winners, HomeSense, Marshalls and Amazon due to fall hazard.
 The company reported 25,088 units of the affected products were sold in Canada between January 2022 and September 2026.
 As of Oct. 19, the company hasn’t received any reports of injury or incidents in Canada.

 Metroland Staff 
 Product recall: Simmons Kozy and Nido baby nests and loungers
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Issue Fall risk. Health Canada determined the baby nests and loungers don’t meet cribs, cradles and bassinets regulations in Canada
 Where sold 25,088 units of the affected products were sold in Canada from January 2022 to September 2026, including through Walmart, Winners, HomeSense, Marshalls and Amazon 
 What to do  Immediately stop using the recalled baby loungers and nests and dispose in a way that it can’t be used again.
 Place of origin China

 What does Health Canada recommend for safe sleep?
 Health Canada tells parents and caregivers the safest place for a baby to sleep is on their back on a firm, flat surface intended for sleep.
 You can find more information on safe sleeping practices for infants online .
 How to report an issue with a consumer product, drug, cannabis or food
 You can report a food concern or complaint to  CFIA  online.
 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Consumers can report any health or safety incidents related to the use of products by filling out a  consumer product incident report form .
 To report a health or safety complaint with a cannabis product, fill out the  cannabis reporting form  online.
 Report any drug or health product  side effects  or  complaints  to Health Canada.
 You can check for more recall notices published by  Health Canada and CFIA online .
